steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ stage can be configured.
Provide the required event title.
Use an RFQ stage, which supports vendor bidding and counter offers.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add a line item for the vendor quote.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor to bid and answer the counter offer.
Publish the event so the vendor can submit a bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit the initial quote required for a counter offer.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the counter offer can be sent.
Send a counter offer to the vendor's bid.
Confirm the buyer grid records the counter offer as initiated.
Have the vendor answer the pending counter offer by accepting it.
Confirm the buyer view records that the vendor accepted the counter offer.
Open the stage Settings menu and choose Order Activity.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open.
Check that the activity drawer contains a counter-offer activity entry.
Check that the activity text reflects the answered counter offer.
